# Maxey0 lab

Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

**Installs from this repository.**

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add mmc7676/Maxey0
/plugin install maxey0-lab@maxey0
```

The experiment harness. Research tooling and explicitly not part of the product -- install it only if you are running a study. Nothing in the three planes depends on it.

## What this is

- `plugins/maxey0-lab/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`

- product `Maxey0-SuperSpace`
